text: Jesus has another name. It tells you where God is.
About seven hundred years before Jesus, in King Ahaz's day, God gave a promise through Isaiah, a man who spoke God's message:
Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
Mary, a virgin, who had never been with a man, was pregnant by God's Holy Spirit.
An angel told her husband Joseph:
thou shalt call his name JESUS: for he shall save his people from their sins.
Matthew's book about Jesus says the promise came true. Jesus is that promised son, and His other name, Immanuel, means: God with us.
With us as a baby. With us at the cross, where He died for our sins. On the third day, He rose from the dead. He promised:
